The item-side half of the accidental-pointerup guard: an item only sees a defaultPrevented pointerup when the content overlays the press point at delta<=10px, i.e. in item-aligned positioning where the selected item opens under the pointer. This fixture uses position=popper with side-offset 5, whose nearest item sits ~35px from any trigger press point, so no real pointer can reach the line. jsdom reached it via the synthetic double-pointerup ritual.

The fixture's Close button @click. Unreachable by pointer (modal body pointer-events:none) and unsafely reachable by keyboard (the content's late focusSelectedItem steals focus back and Enter then selects instead — measured). The port closes via Escape, which drives the same open->false watch; the button handler line is the honest cost.
